settings.hero_title: Talk to a person who actually works here
settings.hero_lede: Orders, shipping, returns, fitment, an install appointment or a fleet — wherever you are in the continental United States, it is the same phone and the same people.
settings.reach_title: Two ways to get an answer
settings.reach_lede: TireDrop is the online store of Extreme Tires, 7712 West Oakland Park Blvd, Sunrise, FL 33351. One phone number, one shop, one set of people — whether you are ordering from Florida or from three states away.
settings.fast_copy: Call. If an order has already been placed, if you are sitting on a flat, or you need something changed before it ships, the phone beats the form every time — the person who answers can pull the order up while you are talking.
settings.phone_copy: Order status, shipping questions, returns, fitment advice, install appointments and fleet accounts.
settings.phone_note: The phone is the channel that reaches a person fastest, and the form below reaches the same people.
settings.email_copy: One address for everything — orders, returns, fleet quotes and dealer paperwork. Include an order number if you have one. If it cannot wait, call instead.
settings.shop_copy: Extreme Tires, the shop behind TireDrop — for pickups, installs and anything easier to explain in person.
settings.hours_note: Eastern time. The store takes orders around the clock; people answer during the hours above.
settings.message_lede: Include an order number if you have one. Messages sent outside business hours get picked up the next morning we are open. If it is urgent, call instead — the form is not monitored around the clock.

settings.ph_message: Order number if you have one. Otherwise: year, make and model, tire size, and whether you want it shipped to you or to the shop.
settings.privacy_note: We use what you send here to answer your question and nothing else. It is not added to a mailing list — there isn't one — and it is not passed to anyone outside the shop. See our privacy policy.
settings.success_copy: Thanks for reaching out. A real person reads these during the hours listed on this page, and will reply by email or phone. We do not put a clock on that, because we would rather answer properly than answer fast.
settings.success_urgent: If the car is down right now, or your order needs changing before it ships, do not wait on the reply — the phone is the only channel we treat as urgent. Call
settings.error_title: We could not get that through just now.
settings.error_copy: Your message did not go through, so nobody here has read it yet. Fix what is marked below and send it again — or call, and the person who answers can help straight away.
settings.cta_title: A lot of it is already answered
settings.cta_lede: How shipping works, what ship-to-store costs, and what happens if a tire shows up wrong — all written out, no hold music.
